how.title: From CV to portfolio in three steps

how.3.title: Generate & Customize

upload.title: Upload your CV
upload.subtitle: PDF or DOCX, up to 10MB. We extract text on the server — files are never stored permanently.
upload.privacy: Your CV is processed securely. Your personal information is not stored in a central database. Extracted text is sent to the AI provider only when you request AI generation.
upload.error.type: Unsupported format. Please upload a PDF or DOCX file.
upload.error.size: File is too large. Maximum size is 10MB.
upload.error.empty: This file appears empty or has no extractable text. Scanned PDFs need OCR — try exporting your CV as a text-based PDF or DOCX.
upload.error.corrupt: We couldn't read this file. It may be corrupted — please try another export.
profession.title: What best describes you?
